critical_code_review_comments: services/enterprise_intelligence.py autocapture_from_approval swallows ALL exceptions via a bare except — same concern as prior iterations. If Emergent LLM key becomes invalid or the enterprise_role_memories collection has an index conflict, the caller will silently get 0 with no log. Add at least a logger.warning('autocapture skipped: %s', e) so ops can trace silent no-ops. Reference: /app/backend/services/enterprise_intelligence.py:351-352.

routes/approvals.py decide_approval spawns asyncio.create_task(autocapture_from_approval(...)) but never awaits or stores the task. Under load or short-lived request lifecycles the task may be GC'd before it runs (Python asyncio warns 'Task was destroyed but it is pending!'). Consider using a background-task helper (asyncio.shield or FastAPI BackgroundTasks) to guarantee execution. Reference: /app/backend/routes/approvals.py:262-266.

routes/approvals.py imports 'from services.enterprise_intelligence import autocapture_from_approval' inside the handler — fine for lazy loading, but it runs on every approve call. Move to a module-level import to save the ~microseconds and to fail-loud on module-import errors instead of at first approval.

mobile/app/enterprise/[id].tsx CaptureModal calls onDone() only when r.proposed > 0; if the LLM returns 0 proposed items, it shows msg ('Nothing worth preserving found') but does NOT close the modal — user must Cancel. Consider auto-closing after 2s with the toast still visible so it doesn't feel stuck.

mobile/app/enterprise/ask/[roleId].tsx does not cap `turns` length — a long session can render 50+ turns in a single ScrollView. For parity with web, consider a soft cap or lazy-render / virtualization.

mobile/app/enterprise/index.tsx openTab() caches the first fetch per tab (`if (t === 'Risk' && !risk)`), but never refreshes even after a capture on a person profile. If the user captures new memory and returns to Risk/Review tab, they see stale data until pull-to-refresh (which is not implemented). Consider re-fetching on focus + invalidating cache after mutations, OR add a refresh control.
